purpose: Define masking, aggregation, pseudonymization and other derived views as explicit transformations that preserve provenance and do not silently declassify source data.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Derivation
topics.purpose: Define masking, aggregation, pseudonymization and other derived views as explicit transformations that preserve provenance and do not silently declassify source data.

semantics.source_rule: Exact source fields/resources and revisions are referenced.
semantics.declassification_rule: Privacy transform does not automatically make output public/unrestricted.
semantics.reidentification_rule: Re-identification capability/risk is governed explicitly where relevant.
semantics.authority_rule: Derived view grants no source access.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

references.purpose: DWH masking/redaction follows explicit derived-view semantics.
